title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Double With Towel Bar Solid Brass | Satin Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized bathroom storage with this wall mount glass shelf featuring two tiers and an integrated towel bar in Satin Brass, which combines warm golden tones with a brushed texture, bringing modern warmth without the high shine of polished brass. From the Waverly Place collection, it combines 3/8-inch thick tempered glass with solid brass hardware, and a gallery rail helps keep toiletries and accessories from sliding.

Highlights:
- Satin Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Solid brass hardware with solid brass gallery rail to help secure items
- Integrated towel bar for hand towels or washcloths
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look

Specs:
- Dimensions: 16-inch length x 5-inch width x 12-inch height; 5-inch projection
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Mounting type: wall mount
- Assembly required: no
- Included items: glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4-inch
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Pairs well with transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories in the Waverly Place collection.
